statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-31808 (GHSA-5v7r-6r5c-r473) is an infinite loop in the file-type ASF parser when a sub-header does not advance the tokenizer. The installed file-type 16.5.4 copy includes the position guard from https://github.com/sindresorhus/file-type/commit/319abf871b50ba2fa221b4a7050059f1ae096f4f, which breaks the loop when the read position does not advance.

CVE-2026-31808 (GHSA-5v7r-6r5c-r473) is an infinite loop in the file-type ASF parser when a sub-header does not advance the tokenizer. The installed file-type 16.5.4 copy includes the position guard from https://github.com/sindresorhus/file-type/commit/319abf871b50ba2fa221b4a7050059f1ae096f4f, which breaks the loop when the read position does not advance.
